title: TN police detain hundreds of hospital workers ahead of Chennai protest

ai.summary: Tamil Nadu police detained hundreds of multi-purpose hospital workers ahead of a hunger strike in Chennai demanding permanent employment and benefits.

facts.claim: Tamil Nadu police detained hundreds of multi-purpose hospital workers
facts.quote: The Tamil Nadu police on Monday, October 12, detained hundreds of multi-purpose hospital workers, as they attempted to stage a hunger strike in Chennai demanding permanent employment and other benefits.

facts.claim: Workers from several districts were allegedly placed under house arrest
facts.quote: Workers from several districts were allegedly placed under house arrest before they could reach the city for the protest.

According to the Multi-purpose Hospital Workers Development Association, 339 workers were detained across 20 districts and those who reached Chennai to stage a protest near Rajarathinam Stadium in Egmore were also arrested.

facts.claim: More than 2,500 multi-purpose hospital workers are employed on a daily-wage basis in government hospitals
facts.quote: According to the workers' association, more than 2,500 multi-purpose hospital workers are employed on a daily-wage basis in government hospitals across the state in jobs like cleaning, sanitation and patient assistance.

facts.claim: Workers were appointed on a temporary basis in 2013 and 2014
facts.quote: They were appointed on a temporary basis in 2013 and 2014 through the joint directors of the health department in each district.

facts.claim: Despite completing five years of service, workers have not been regularised
facts.quote: Despite completing five years of service, the workers have not been regularised and continue to work on daily wages.

facts.claim: The workers had announced a hunger strike at Rajarathinam Stadium in Chennai's Egmore
facts.quote: The association had now announced a hunger strike at Rajarathinam Stadium in Chennai's Egmore on Monday, calling for job regularisation, a monthly day off and other demands.

facts.claim: Police denied permission for the protest
facts.quote: Police personnel deployed at the spot arrested the protestors, transported them in government vehicles, and kept them at nearby community halls.

ai.background_note: Tamil Nadu hospital workers, employed on daily wages since 2013, have demanded permanent employment and benefits after five years of service without regularization.
